# Cinema Hall Kit

> A TypeScript workspace for describing cinema halls and building React seat selection and hall
> construction experiences. Includes a Next.js demo with an in-memory mock backend.

## Start here

- [Live demo](https://cinema-hall-kit.freemyip.com): interactive demo of hall construction and seat selection.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/shanja-glinka/cinema-hall-kit): source code, packages, and documentation.
- [README](README.md): overview, clone and run commands, demo routes, and license.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): prerequisites, workspace setup, checks, and package boundaries.
- [Agent guidance](AGENTS.md): repository-specific coding-agent instructions.
- [API reference](docs/api.md): public core and React APIs, customization, and backend integration.
- [Requirements](docs/requirements.md): intended behavior and acceptance criteria.
- [API decisions](docs/api-decisions.md): recorded public API review decisions.
- [Deployment notes](docs/deployment.md): build/start commands and in-memory demo limitations.
- [License and notices](NOTICE.md): 0BSD scope, third-party assets, and dependency licenses.

## Packages and demo

- [Core package](packages/core/README.md): framework-free TypeScript APIs and CLI.
- [React package](packages/react/README.md): React components, hooks, theme, labels, and styles.
- [Demo guide](apps/demo/README.md): Next.js routes, sample halls, mock backend, and Playwright usage.
- [Demo asset credits](apps/demo/CREDITS.md): source and licensing notes for demo media.
- [Sample hall configuration](docs/examples/meridian-hall-3.yaml): commented YAML example.

## Install the published kit

Run `npm install @cinema-hall/react @cinema-hall/core react react-dom three @react-three/fiber motion`
in the consuming React application, then import `@cinema-hall/react/styles.css` once.
For framework-free use, install only `@cinema-hall/core`.

- [Core on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cinema-hall/core)
- [React on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cinema-hall/react)

## Common commands

Run from the repository root after installing with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`:

- `pnpm build` builds core, React, and demo.
- `pnpm --filter demo dev` starts the demo at `http://localhost:3000`.
- `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm lint` validate the workspace.
- `pnpm check:publish` and `pnpm check:licenses` check package publication metadata and dependency licenses.
